title: Add TRP Coins rewards, teams with TRP cost/member limit, and admin-managed Seasons/System tab

requirements.text: Implement TRP Coins as the in-app currency name and award 900–1000 TRP Coins at the end of each completed non-practice race, shown on the Race Results scoreboard.

quotes: I want a currency where when you race at the end you see a score board where you can gain 900-1000 acoints and the coines is called trp coins

acceptanceCriteria: Race Results UI uses the label "TRP Coins" (not generic "Currency") for earned and balance displays.
For non-practice races, the awarded amount displayed on Race Results is an integer within [900, 1000].
For practice races, awarded TRP Coins is 0 and the user balance is not changed.
Awarding TRP Coins is enforced by the backend (frontend cannot directly change balance).

requirements.text: Add backend support to credit TRP Coins to the caller’s profile balance when a non-practice race is completed, and return the awarded amount to the frontend as part of the race completion flow.

quotes: when you race at the end you see a score board where you can gain 900-1000 acoints

acceptanceCriteria: A new or updated backend API exists that the frontend can call after a race completes to (a) persist the race performance, (b) update best performance/leaderboards, and (c) atomically credit TRP Coins to the caller’s profile balance.
The backend updates the stored UserProfile.balance by the awarded TRP Coins amount for non-practice races.
The backend returns (at minimum) the awarded TRP Coins amount and the caller’s resulting balance (or enough information for the frontend to refresh and display it).
If the caller does not have a profile or is not authorized as a user, the backend rejects the operation with a clear error.

requirements.text: Add admin capabilities to grant an arbitrary amount of TRP Coins (including very large amounts) and expose this via an admin UI and/or existing admin command flow.

quotes: admins get as much as they want

acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides an admin-only method to grant TRP Coins to a specified user (including self).
Non-admin callers cannot grant TRP Coins and receive an authorization error.
Admin UI provides a way to input a Principal and an amount, execute the grant, and show success/error feedback.
If the existing admin command assistant is used for currency grants, it supports a command form that clearly grants TRP Coins (and the UI labels it as TRP Coins).

requirements.text: Implement Teams in the backend with: team creation costing 50,000 TRP Coins, a hard limit of 100 members per team, and membership management APIs for listing teams and viewing team details.

quotes: For the teams add a place where you can make a team for 50000 trp which in the team there is a limit of 100 people.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes APIs to: create a team (name required), list teams, get team details by id, and join/leave a team (or equivalent membership management).
Creating a team deducts exactly 50,000 TRP Coins from the creator’s UserProfile.balance in the same call that creates the team.
If the caller has insufficient TRP Coins, team creation fails with an "Insufficient balance"-style error.
A team cannot exceed 100 members; joining fails once the limit is reached.
Team details include at minimum: team id, name, owner, member count, and member principals (or enough info to display a member list).

requirements.text: Replace the placeholder Teams pages with real UI backed by the backend teams APIs, including a create-team flow showing the 50,000 TRP Coins cost and enforcing the 100-member limit in the UI.

quotes: add a place where you can make a team for 50000 trp ... limit of 100 people

acceptanceCriteria: /teams shows a list of teams from the backend (loading/empty/error states handled).
/teams provides a create-team UI (dialog or inline form) that clearly states the cost: "50,000 TRP Coins".
After successful creation, the new team appears in the list without a full page refresh (React Query invalidation/refetch is acceptable).
/teams/$teamId shows team details and member list from the backend.
Team join/leave (or equivalent) actions update the UI and respect backend errors (including "team full" when at 100 members).

requirements.text: Add a new "System" tab/page in the main navigation with sections for Winter, Spring, Summer, and a "Secret Holidays" area; Secret Holidays must be admin-managed (add/remove) via backend-backed admin controls.

quotes: Add a system tab which is the winter summer spring and other secret holiday which can be adding a managed by the admins

acceptanceCriteria: The main authenticated navigation includes a link labeled "System" that routes to a new page.
The System page displays Winter, Spring, and Summer as visible sections/tabs.
The System page displays a "Secret Holidays" section listing items from the backend.
Admins can add a new Secret Holiday via UI on the System page (or an admin-only control within it), and non-admin users cannot add/remove Secret Holidays.
Backend persists Secret Holidays and exposes query APIs for all users to read them and admin-only APIs to manage them.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo changes if needed for state upgrades.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths (compose them instead).
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Implementing purchasable shop items priced in TRP Coins (beyond team creation cost).
Real-time team chat or real-time race multiplayer.
Third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity remains supported).
